scientific_integrity: Exact formula proved by finite-field reduction types, Hensel factorization and explicit singular-root lifting. Primary comparison is not exhaustive historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes and monic degree-three coefficients modulo \(p^3\) only; no \(p=2\), other degree or precision claim. Exhaustive finite tests \(p=3,5\) are corroboration, not infinite proof.
title: Complete root-count law for random monic cubics modulo odd prime cubes
